field_scope_note: this stress/displacement field describes the SOLID part under the declared load case; a topology-optimized design has different geometry, so optimization INVALIDATES this field
quantization_note: Re-analysis runs on the voxelization of the analyzed mesh at the grid resolution, so the analyzed and printed geometry differ by up to ~half a voxel. The stress margin and voxel mass describe the voxel proxy; the mesh mass is the surface-enclosed volume.
